description: Trigger a media download from the real matched element via the native page anchor behavior. Requires a previously armed browser.download_arm grant; retrieve only through browser.download_wait and its artifact result. Optional target_id addresses only that already-owned page without selecting, creating or focusing it. Requires the declared native browser transport.

timeout_ms.description: Effective locator maximum is 3000ms; sequential typing maximum is 5000ms. Typed clicks separately observe load start for 250ms and completion for at most 3000ms; load_waits reports the actual outcome. Other typed actions do not add a navigation-settling wait.

target_id.description: Exact already-owned page returned by browser.tabs or browser.tab_new. This does not select, show, create, or focus that page.
